PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 2: AP62200WU-7 assigns SW (SW) whereas AP63203WU-7 assigns EN (EN) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 4: AP62200WU-7 assigns FB (FB) whereas AP63203WU-7 assigns GND (GND) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

parameter_matrix.note: Synchronous rectification eliminates external Schottky diode loss and PCB area.
Compact WSON/VSON/SOT-563 packages demand tight hot-loop layout and thermal vias.
Verify cold-start minimum startup voltage and bus surge ceiling.
Provides transient overshoot margin above nominal DC supply bus.
Fixed-output variants save divider BOM; adjustable parts allow arbitrary rail tuning.
For boost converters, usable Iout ≈ Isw × (Vin / Vout) × η minus half ripple ΔIL/2.
Dominates light-load efficiency and standby battery runtime.
Higher fsw shrinks inductor footprint; lower fsw reduces switching losses & high-band EMI.
Check datasheet efficiency curve at your exact Vin/Vout/Iout operating point.
Ensure inductor Isat exceeds worst-case peak switch current by >= 20–30%.
Any Vref discrepancy requires recalculating feedback divider R1/R2.
Lower θJA improves continuous load thermal headroom on compact 2-layer PCBs.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs FB), Pin 2 (SW vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs GND), Pin 5 (EN vs SW). Soldering AP63203WU-7 onto a AP62200WU-7 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 32% (AP62200WU-7: 750 kHz p.5 vs AP63203WU-7: 1100 kHz p.5); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
HIGH FEEDBACK CONFIGURATION: One converter is fixed-output while the other is adjustable; external R1/R2 feedback resistors and feedforward capacitor must be updated.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (AP62200WU-7: 18 V p.4 vs AP63203WU-7: 32 V p.4); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.
engineering_verdict: AP62200WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and AP63203WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs FB), Pin 2 (SW vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs GND), Pin 5 (EN vs SW). Key datasheet deltas: topology is buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency is 750 kHz (p.5) vs 1100 kHz (p.5), rated current is 2000 mA (p.1) vs 2000 mA (p.1), typical inductor is 3.3 µH (p.17) vs 3.9 µH (p.13), and Iq is 135 µA (p.5) vs 22 µA (p.5). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.1), thermal margin (θJA 70 vs 89 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
